title: 三借芭蕉扇
subtitle: 真心合作吹散热浪
origin: 《西游记》第五十九至六十一回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 误会要靠事实和沟通化解；当我们先看见别人的需要、一起解决问题，信任就会慢慢生长。
moral.en: Misunderstandings can be cleared through facts and conversation. Trust grows when we notice others' needs and solve problems together.

pages.zh: 前方就是火焰山。山石红彤彤，热浪让道路发亮，山脚村庄的水渠也快干了。
pages.en: Flaming Mountain rose ahead. Its red rocks shimmered with heat, and the village channels at its foot were nearly dry.

pages.en: Wukong and Tang Seng politely asked Princess Iron Fan for help. Worried the fan might be taken away and leave the village unprotected, she declined.

pages.zh: 一位村民借来一把绿色小扇，大家误以为它也有神奇凉风。八戒认真扇了半天，热浪却一点没变。
pages.en: A villager lent them a little green fan, and everyone mistook it for a magical one. Bajie fanned earnestly, but the heat did not change at all.

pages.zh: 大家不再只顾着过山，而是先帮村民修水渠。悟空抬石板，八戒清淤泥，沙僧测水位，唐僧和白龙马运来清水。
pages.en: Instead of thinking only about crossing, the travelers first helped repair the village channels. Wukong lifted stones, Bajie cleared mud, Sha Seng checked the water level, and Tang Seng and White Dragon Horse brought clean water.

pages.en: When the Bull Demon King returned, he and Princess Iron Fan inspected the dry well and the newly repaired channel. They saw the travelers truly wanted to help, and the misunderstanding cleared.

pages.en: On their third request, Tang Seng explained they needed the fan only to clear the heat from the road and would return it at once. Princess Iron Fan and Bull Demon King agreed to come along.

pages.en: Princess Iron Fan gently waved the great fan toward the empty road while Bull Demon King and Wukong watched the wind. A cool breeze carried the heat away, and the red mountain grew calm.

pages.en: The travelers returned the fan and thanked Princess Iron Fan, Bull Demon King, and the villagers. Beyond the now-cool pass, a glittering little temple appeared in the distance.
